expected.exit_basis: contract-declared placeholder corroborated by the reference child process exit; the product runner ABI is UNBOUND
expected.exit_semantics: A positive case succeeds only if the case child process exits 0 AND the typed token is emitted AND every predicate holds. The engine wrapper exit is not case evidence; exit 0 alone is NOT a product PASS. The product runner ABI is UNBOUND in this set.

predicates.assertion: Exactly five pins are present (source, candidate, evidence, oracle, case_set) and all five hex values are pairwise distinct.
Each reopened pin value equals the corresponding value in FREEZE_LEDGER.json; no pin is recomputed from design bytes.
predicates.verify: for k in 5 pins: record.observed.evidence.pins[k] == ledger.pins[k].value

predicates.assertion: The pack tree digest before and after the case is identical to f97238f5...88df; the case has zero write effect on the pack.
pins, fixture_time and host_policy are three separate fields, not collapsed into the pin map.
The source pin is unchanged and no source byte was rewritten by the freeze check.
The case child process exits 0 and the engine wrapper also exits 0; both are required for a positive exit.

predicate_contract: Each predicate is independently checkable from the produced case record or from the real filesystem. A token match alone never satisfies the oracle; all predicates must hold.
not_covered: Real W2/W3 five-pin preimages for a product freeze are not independently re-signed here; product freeze runner is UNBOUND; the two design pins (oracle, case_set) are still PROPOSED_DESIGN_*; design digests are not product identity.
freeze_rule: expected-before-observed; this oracle was frozen before the product run; an oracle change requires a CR and a new case revision; an old FAIL is preserved
